entities.name: A1K4K7
observations: Exact sequence match (589 aa) to reviewed Azoarcus sp. isocitrate dehydrogenase kinase/phosphatase.
Bifunctionally phosphorylates and dephosphorylates isocitrate dehydrogenase, regulating carbon flux between TCA and glyoxylate pathways.
Annotated cytoplasmic; ATP- and AMP-binding; kinase EC 2.7.11.5 and phosphatase EC 3.1.3.-.
